segments.caption: The video opens on the exterior of Saigon Sandwich, a Vietnamese sandwich shop in San Francisco, with pedestrians walking past on the sidewalk. The camera then moves inside, revealing the shop’s interior: a framed award for “Best Sandwich, San Francisco” and “Best Bay Area Winner 2010” sits prominently on a shelf next to a menu board listing Vietnamese sandwich options like “Thit Cha” and “Jambon,” alongside a 7UP logo. The

Inside a bustling Vietnamese sandwich shop, staff prepare and serve food behind a counter laden with ingredients and packaged goods, while a customer holds up a freshly made banh mi, showcasing its vibrant fillings.

A person holds a freshly made banh mi sandwich, wrapped in white paper, and rotates it slightly to display its colorful fillings of pickled carrots, daikon, and fresh herbs against a backdrop of a paved sidewalk.
A person enjoys a fresh, vegetable-filled sandwich while standing on a city sidewalk, with pigeons foraging nearby and a grand building displaying "Shanghai" banners in the background.

A person eats a sandwich while standing in a public plaza, drawing the attention of numerous pigeons and seagulls that gather around, some approaching curiously as people and traffic move in the background.
A person walks through a public plaza filled with pigeons, including a prominent seagull, while holding a fresh banh mi sandwich topped with cilantro and carrots, capturing a casual urban moment.

A person holds a freshly made banh mi sandwich, topped with vibrant cilantro and carrots, while standing among a flock of pigeons on a paved surface, creating a moment of urban street food and nature coexisting.
A person holds a partially eaten sandwich while several pigeons gather on the pavement nearby, with one pigeon in particular stepping forward and pecking at the ground, seemingly eyeing the food.
A pigeon stands on a gravel path, then walks away as a corgi, wearing a harness and accompanied by a person, sniffs the ground and moves toward a grassy area near a lamppost.

A person walks outdoors, briefly glimpsed from behind as their corgi sniffs at a lamppost on a grassy verge. The scene then shifts to a close-up of the person's hand holding a clear plastic cup filled with a layered dessert—likely a sweet rice pudding or tapioca drink—with a white foam topping and a small plastic spoon tucked against the side, set against a blurred asphalt background.

A person holds a clear plastic cup of a layered dessert with a white foam topping, then uses a plastic spoon to scoop and lift a portion of the dessert, revealing its texture and ingredients against a blurred asphalt background.

A person is eating a dessert from a clear plastic cup while outdoors on a paved surface, then transitions to unwrapping and eating a translucent, jelly-like food item from a leafy wrapper while seated.
A person carefully unwraps a steamed fish fillet, revealing its moist, white flesh nestled within a leaf and plastic wrapper, while seated outdoors on a paved surface.
A person unwraps a steamed, leaf-wrapped rice dumpling and uses a plastic fork to take a bite, savoring the soft, sticky interior while seated outdoors on a paved surface.

A young man eats a piece of fish from a plastic spoon while sitting outdoors on a sidewalk, with a suitcase beside him and a woman on her phone nearby; the scene captures a casual, on-the-go meal in an urban setting.

A young man with a suitcase sits on a sidewalk in San Francisco, looking down and speaking, while a woman sits beside him holding a phone. The video ends with on-screen credits thanking Saigon Sandwiches at 560 Larkin St., San Francisco, CA, and displaying the website geoffmobile.com.
